the relationships between anthropometric parameters and strength in children.

the anthropometric characteristics are important for the hand strength in children, but the influence is different in boys and girls and in different age groups.
the hand anthropometry is a useful additional tool to the basic anthropometry in the prediction of the handgripp and pinch strength in prepubertally children.
the handgrip force is a complex phenomenon and its prediction requires the knowledge of both basic body and specific hand anthropometric measurements.

the basic and specific hand and body anthropometric parameters are important for the prediction of the handgrips strength in children.
